title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.06131v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Static and incomplete parametric knowledge limits the performance of multimodal large language models on novel-knowledge and knowledge-intensive tasks, especially those requiring multi-hop evidence acquisition. Existing multimodal agentic search methods often fix visual evidence at the input or a predefined trajectory position, making it difficult for agents to select search modalities as their information needs evolve and to handle complex real-world queries. We define this capability as autonomous cross-modal search: an agent chooses among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search, actively introduces visual evidence when appropriate, and switches between and integrates modalities across multiple hops. We propose ModalSearch-Pipeline, a scalable procedure for constructing an interleaved multimodal knowledge graph. It samples paths with diverse depths and modality compositions and uses backwar

translated_title: ModalSearcher：将视觉证据编织进自主跨模态深度搜索
translated_abstract: 静态且不完整的参数化知识限制了多模态大语言模型在新颖知识和知识密集型任务上的性能，尤其是那些需要多跳证据获取的任务。现有多模态智能体搜索方法通常将视觉证据固定在输入端或预定义的轨迹位置上，使得智能体难以随着信息需求的演变来选择搜索模态，也难以处理复杂的现实世界查询。我们将这种能力定义为自主跨模态搜索：智能体可以在直接推理、文本到文本搜索、文本到图像搜索和反向图像搜索之间进行选择，在适当时机主动引入视觉证据，并在多跳过程中在不同模态之间切换与整合。我们提出了ModalSearch-Pipeline，这是一种用于构建交错多模态知识图谱的可扩展流程。它采样具有不同深度和模态组合的路径，并使用反向……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出自主跨模态搜索新范式ModalSearcher，使智能体能在直接推理、文本搜索、文图搜索与反向图搜之间自主决策，在多跳搜索中动态引入并整合视觉证据，并配套可扩展的ModalSearch-Pipeline构建交错多模态知识图谱以支持训练。
en_tdlr: ModalSearcher introduces autonomous cross-modal search, enabling agents to dynamically choose among direct reasoning, text-to-text search, text-to-image search, and reverse-image search while weaving visual evidence across multi-hop queries, supported by a scalable pipeline that constructs interleaved multimodal knowledge graphs.
